name: Obkhod-Tonkino Gas Pipeline (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Mezhposelkovy gas pipeline from GRS Obkhod (Urensky district) to Tonkino
values.StartLocation: GRS Obkhod (gas distribution station near Obkhod village)
values.RouteNotes: No published route or GIS found; only endpoints (GRS Obkhod, Urensky district to Tonkino). Not mapped.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW, no roster match (roster has no Nizhny Novgorod northern-gasification row; same class as P3973/P3974 inter-settlement Gazprom regional-programme lines, PipelineType distribution, Owner Gazprom PJSC). Threshold: (a) sponsor = Gazprom (regional gasification programme signed 2021 by governor Nikitin and Gazprom CEO Miller, vz-nn; Gazprom investment raised to 26.3 bn rub per gipernn 2024-12; programme reported by Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Nizhny Novgorod, gipernn 2026-01). Owner inferred from programme; no source names the line's legal owner/operator explicitly (gas distribution assets may end up with a Gazprom gazoraspredelenie subsidiary): flag for human check. (b) endpoints GRS Obkhod (Urensky) -> Tonkino. (c) concrete step = construction under way: niann.ru/vz-nn (2026-01-21, from regional energy minister Kurenkov to the Legislative Assembly committee) 'Межпоселковый газопровод от ГРС Обход Уренского района до Тонкино: протяженность 31 км, выполнен на 39,7%'; completion of works planned 2026, commissioning 2027 (aif-nn, mk-nn, vz-nn). (d) length 31 km sourced by two outlets (niann.ru and vz-nn.ru both trace to the same ministry briefing, so not independent publishers of the number; independent flag reflects distinct outlets, tier kept medium; construction status caps at medium). Distinct from obkhod-shakhunya (Obkhod-Shakhunya 32 km) and from the 30 km trunk to GRS Obkhod itself; the Tonkino-Sharanga continuation (24.5 km) is <25 km, separate monitor item. Capacity, diameter, cost, contractor not found (searched niann, gipernn, aif, mk, web search). ProposalYear not sourced (design 2025-2026 per gipernn 2024-12; not cited as a value). Status as of Jan 2026 (39.7% complete); Sept 2026 reporting covers only the Shakhunya line, so Tonkino status not refreshed since. Route: none found, RouteType Unavailable/no route.
